scope: Flink rule application receipt PostgreSQL transition and idempotency acceptance
verificationSql: SELECT application_status, application_deployment_id, revision, application_received_at FROM bpi.bpi_outbox_events WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND id = :publication_id;
SELECT count(*) FROM bpi.bpi_inbox_events WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND source = 'bpi.boundary.rule-application.v1';
SELECT action, before_revision, after_revision FROM bpi.bpi_audit_events WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND object_id = :publication_id ORDER BY after_revision;

uiAcceptance.test: frontend/apps/bpi/tests/bpi-console.e2e.cjs: process engineer replays PostgreSQL evidence and publishes a checksum-gated rule
assertions: Kafka PUBLISHED and Flink APPLIED are rendered as separate states.
REJECTED shows deployment, observed/received timestamps, error code and detail.
APPLIED clears stale rejection details and keeps the drawer inside the viewport.
Browser console, page and request errors are zero.

limitations: This evidence does not claim a live Kafka/Flink checkpoint round trip.
Browser status acceptance uses the deterministic simulator and does not claim a browser-to-Java-to-Kafka/Flink round trip.
This evidence does not claim target test-environment deployment.
Kafka retry/DLQ and checkpoint/restart acceptance remain required before G-021 can advance.
